editorial:
Imagine working your tail off for years at a fancy law firm, doing all the dirty work, and finally being one step away from the top. That is exactly where you find our main character, a shark of a lawyer who wins cases for people everyone else hates. She is a machine, but her perfect world gets shaken up when a new, charismatic attorney joins the team. Suddenly, the promotion she thought was hers is up for grabs, and the movie turns into a high-stakes game of cat and mouse. It feels like a tense office battle where the weapons are secrets and lies instead of guns.

What really hits home is the acting, as you can feel the stress building up in every scene. The plot moves quickly, though a few parts in the middle drag a bit. If you like stories about people fighting for power, you will love this. For the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the sharp details of the city skyline. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call because the sound design is top-notch.
endingExplained: You will find out that the new lawyer was actually hired by the firm's bosses to find dirt on the main character. In the final scenes, she tries to frame her rival, but it backfires completely. The twist is that her own clients leaked her secrets to the new guy. She loses the partner position and gets fired in disgrace, proving that the people she defended were never actually on her side.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves legal dramas and stories about workplace rivalry.
